# Rule 14 - Continuity Guidelines Some information, continuity, and memory is carried between rounds on Spectra, within set limits.
You can only remember information from shifts that you survive. This means if you are killed, you forget the shift completely. If your body is revivable when it reaches CentComm, you also remember the shift but you forget all of the details leading up to your death per Rule 3.
[bold]Any information that is [textlink="Metashielded" link="Metashield"][/bold] is forgotten between shifts.
Examples of things you [bold]can[/bold] remember: - Social interactions with another character, such as getting drinks at the bar or even getting into an argument - Which jobs characters usually work- though this may not be used to meta that something is 'up' if someone isn't working their usual job - The layout of the station, though some leeway should be given for forgetting secret rooms. - Witnessing a Hollow body or seeing a Changeling eat someone - Nuclear Operatives attacking the station - As NanoTrasen Representative, remembering that last shift had Nuclear Operatives - Joe the Botanist was a Syndicate who stole the Captain's Jetpack
Examples of things you [bold]can't[/bold] remember: - CentComm calling Code Epsilon and killing a bunch of people on the station - Exact specifics on antagonist mechanics outside of that role. (IE. Security lethalling a changeling instead of arresting without ROE because "All changelings can break cuffs.") - Specifics on the exact mechanics of antagonist gear. (IE. Security lethalling something invisible without ROE because "It could be a stealth suit nukie." - Things explicitly declared to be noncanon. (Usually an announcement will be made before something noncanon happens. Details that are NOT part of the noncanon event can be kept. You can remember talking with someone after admins declare end of canon, but you cant remember that an admin spawned a sentient immovable rod on centcomm after end of canon.)
